From 30e9857a134905ac0d03ca244b615cc3ff0a076e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Bjorn Andersson <bjorn.andersson@linaro.org>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2021 11:07:02 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] pinctrl: qcom: Make it possible to select SC8180x TLMM

It's currently not possible to select the SC8180x TLMM driver, due to it
selecting PINCTRL_MSM, rather than depending on the same. Fix this.

Fixes: 97423113ec4b ("pinctrl: qcom: Add sc8180x TLMM driver")
Signed-off-by: Bjorn Andersson <bjorn.andersson@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210608180702.2064253-1-bjorn.andersson@linaro.org
Signed-off-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>

diff --git a/drivers/pinctrl/qcom/Kconfig b/drivers/pinctrl/qcom/Kconfig
index 25d2f7f7f3b6..11e967dbb44b 100644
--- a/drivers/pinctrl/qcom/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/pinctrl/qcom/Kconfig
@@ -223,7 +223,7 @@ config PINCTRL_SC7280
 config PINCTRL_SC8180X
 	tristate "Qualcomm Technologies Inc SC8180x pin controller driver"
 	depends on GPIOLIB && (OF || ACPI)
-	select PINCTRL_MSM
+	depends on PINCTRL_MSM
 	help
 	  This is the pinctrl, pinmux, pinconf and gpiolib driver for the
 	  Qualcomm Technologies Inc TLMM block found on the Qualcomm
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/pinctrl/qcom/Kconfig`**
   - The line that previously stated `select PINCTRL_MSM` has been changed to `depends on PINCTRL_MSM`. This modification alters the way the SC8180x pin controller driver interacts with the PINCTRL_MSM configuration, ensuring that it now properly depends on it rather than selecting it.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The change from `select` to `depends on` establishes a more appropriate relationship between the SC8180x pin controller driver and the PINCTRL_MSM configuration. This ensures that the SC8180x driver can only be enabled if the PINCTRL_MSM is explicitly selected, which resolves the issue of it being unselectable due to the previous configuration. This modification is aimed at fixing the bug introduced in a prior commit (identified by the hash 97423113ec4b) that added the SC8180x TLMM driver.

pinctrl: qcom: Make it possible to select SC8180x TLMM

It's currently not possible to select the SC8180x TLMM driver, due to it
selecting PINCTRL_MSM, rather than depending on the same. Fix this.

Fixes: 97423113ec4b ("pinctrl: qcom: Add sc8180x TLMM driver")
Signed-off-by: Bjorn Andersson <bjorn.andersson@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210608180702.2064253-1-bjorn.andersson@linaro.org
Signed-off-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the SC8180x TLMM driver using `select PINCTRL_MSM`, which made it possible for the driver to be enabled without ensuring that the necessary PINCTRL_MSM configuration was also selected. This created a situation where the driver could not be properly selected, leading to issues in its functionality.

 	depends on GPIOLIB && (OF || ACPI)

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
select PINCTRL_MSM
```
Reason:
The use of `select PINCTRL_MSM` allows the SC8180x TLMM driver to be enabled independently of the necessary PINCTRL_MSM configuration. This means that the driver could be compiled and included without ensuring that the required dependencies and configurations for PINCTRL_MSM were also selected, leading to potential functionality issues.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
depends on PINCTRL_MSM
```
Reason:
Changing `select PINCTRL_MSM` to `depends on PINCTRL_MSM` ensures that the SC8180x TLMM driver can only be enabled if the PINCTRL_MSM configuration is also selected. This enforces the necessary dependency, preventing the driver from being enabled in an unsupported configuration, thus fixing the underlying issue.
